title: [finding] meta(view): GET /api/v1/meta/view/:object answers 500 for a defineView container on an artifact boot — viewTranslationKey reads the absent view.name
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (a), reach measured on a public door.** An authenticated read answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` on a production-shaped boot. Raised by #22521's dev on PR #22612 (report `6094190134`) and carried by the `domain:cli` seat (seat post #6024, `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes. Two places are involved:
- `viewTranslationKey` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (about `:417` at `origin/main` `86f53a4b8d`), which is `domain:spec`'s;
- the by-name `/meta` read that calls it, `translateMetaDocument` in `packages/rest`, which is `domain:cli`'s.

## Measured (base `86f53a4b8d`, a neutral fixture, real boots through the source entry)

- **The read:** `GET /api/v1/meta/view/acme_note`, authenticated as the seeded admin. `acme_note` is the key of a `defineView({ object: 'acme_note', list: { … } })` container.
- **Artifact boot** (`os build`, then boot the artifact) of a **single-package** project: `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`. The server log reads `[REST] Unhandled error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'startsWith')`. The stack runs `viewTranslationKey` ← `resolveViewLabel` ← `translateView` ← `translateMetadataDocument` ← `translateMetaDocument` (rest).
- **Config boot** (`os serve objectstack.config.ts`) of the same project: `200`.

**Why:** `viewTranslationKey(view, objectName)` returns `view.name.startsWith(prefix) ? …`. A view CONTAINER has no own `name`: the registry files it under the object it binds to (`deriveViewContainerObject`). On an artifact boot, the by-name read serves the container from the metadata service, and the translation of the served document reaches `view.name` as `undefined`. The config boot answers from a different registry copy.

**Reach:** every artifact boot (the production shape) serving a `defineView` container, on the by-name view read. The list read and the expanded views (`<object>.<key>`, which carry a `name`) are not measured as affected.

**Expected (shape for triage, not a spec):** the by-name read of a container answers `200` with the container on both doors. Either the translate path does not treat a container as a single view, or it keys the container by its object.
- Pin: an artifact boot and a config boot of one fixture answer the same for `GET /meta/view/<object>`.
- Control: an expanded view's by-name read is unchanged.

**Related, closed:** #20730 (the dashboard reads lacked a packaged base) and #20731 (an org overlay on a packaged view label). Neither is this crash.

## Duplicate check

REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&since=2026-09-15` was paged to the end: 2,561 issues, PRs excluded, closed included, #1883 to #22611. (REST search answers 403 in this container.) A local case-insensitive grep found:
- `viewTranslationKey`: 0 hits;
- `reading 'startsWith'`: 0 hits;
- `meta/view/` within 200 characters of `500`: 0 hits;
- `translateView` / `translateMetaDocument`: 4 hits (#11287, #20730, #20731, #21006, all closed), none of them this crash.

Dedupe words: meta view by-name 500 · viewTranslationKey startsWith undefined · artifact boot view container read 500 · translateView container without name
